confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for July peak season, not checked against live prices or listings. Dining and coffee are moderately reliable. Beer is a 0.5 L serving to match the comparables, though standard Dutch pours are often 0.25 L. Cocktail (about 2.1 times beer) and wine (about 1.2 times beer) follow the beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation is least certain given wide July rate swings and unclear tourist-tax treatment. The FX figure comes from a web search summary that attributes it to RBA pages; I did not open those pages, so verify the 14 October value before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated to the supplied mid-2026 comparables: London as the high reference and Rome and Madrid as lower ones. Amsterdam dining and drinks sit between London and Rome or Madrid, accommodation is close to London's levels, and hostel beds run above all three, reflecting high summer hostel demand.
